description.value: Kye Bay BnB is a quiet seaside bed and breakfast near Comox on Vancouver Island, offering three individually themed private suites—Starfish Cove, Driftwood Cove, and Beachcombers Cove—each with its own private locked entrance and full ensuite bathroom. The property sits a 2–3 minute walk from a wildlife-rich beach and is a 10-minute drive from the town of Comox, making it a tranquil base for exploring the Comox Valley. Guests receive a full hot home-cooked breakfast served on the garden patio or in-room, with food allergy accommodations available.
